description: This line plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) achieved by the GPT-4o model across different values of the number of child nodes, also referred to as tree width, ranging from 1 to 7. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)", uses a linear scale with integer tick marks at 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The plot displays two data series: the first, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, corresponds to the GPT-4o model, starting at an accuracy of 24.4% at a tree width of 1, rising to a peak of 34.4% at a tree width of 5, and then declining to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. The second series, shown as a dashed light blue line with cross markers, also starts at 26.7% at a tree width of 1, rises to 27.8% at a tree width of 3, and then decreases to 20.0% at a tree width of 7.
